j__in__k korean language 06/21/25 In Korean, we often use the word ”꿀(honey)“ to describe anything sweet, delightful, or just really good! 😆🍯 Because 꿀 is literally sweet, people have long used it as a way to describe something delightful like ”꿀잠(sweet sleep)“ and ”꿀맛(delicious taste).“ Later, fun slang evolved: • 꿀팁 (honey + tip): super useful tip • 꿀잼 (honey + fun): really fun • 꿀조합 (honey + combo): perfect match • 꿀템 (honey + item): must-have thing There’s also 꿀피부, 꿀알바, 꿀직장... 꿀 = good vibes 🍯🐝✨ 24 29
